subject: Request: Trial runway extension + usage credit
messages:
From: Kate Morris <kate.morris@armitage.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Trial runway extension + usage credits

Diego,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding last week — the team at Armitage has been running heavy integration tests and we’ve hit a couple of procurement delays that will push back our production decision. Two asks: could we extend the trial runway by three weeks, and can Redwood provide additional usage credits to cover the unexpected spike in token consumption?

Why: Procurement needs extra time to complete the PO and internal security review, but the engineers want to keep testing in the meantime. If we don’t keep the trial active we’ll lose momentum and the pilot won’t show the end-to-end integration.

What we need from you:
- Trial extension: +3 weeks (through Sept 17)
- Usage credit: estimate ~$10–12k to cover testing and demo traffic

We’re prepared to sign the SOW and issue a PO as soon as procurement clears — I can get the procurement team to expedite if there’s a firm end date. I’ve attached the draft SOW for reference.

Appreciate any help here, we’d like to keep this moving.

—Kate
Kate Morris
Head of Platform Partnerships
Armitage Logistics
Attachments: Armitage_SOW_draft.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: Trial runway extension + usage credits — approval needed

Folks, forwarding Kate’s request from Armitage. They’re asking for a 3-week extension and roughly $10–12k of credits. This is outside our standard PLG thresholds (we cap automatic credits at ~$3k / 2 weeks). I recommend we treat this as a discretionary, one-time executive approval because:

- Strategic fit: Armitage is a mid-market logistics platform; they could roll Redwood into several product lines if pilot succeeds.
- Near-term ROI: Procurement has signaled PO intent once the SOW is signed (attached).
- Risk: Approving a large credit sets a precedent; we should document as one-off and attach conditions.

Recommended options (pick one):
1) Approve 2-week extension + $8k credit (conditional on signed SOW/PO within 10 business days).
2) Approve full ask: 3-week extension + $12k credit, but require procurement timeline and exec sponsorship from Armitage (higher risk).
3) Offer a smaller credit + engineering sandbox access and extended demo support (no credits > $5k).

I vote for option 1 to balance momentum and fiscal control. Attaching a usage snapshot to show their current burn.

Attachments: trial_usage_snapshot_20260827.csv

Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Trial runway extension + usage credits — approval needed

Diego — quick question: do we have a clear signal that Armitage will sign the SOW if we grant the extension? Kate said procurement is delayed; need to know if they can commit to a PO date once we grant runway. If they’re unclear, I’d push for stronger commitment (signed SOW or LOI) before larger credits.

If they can promise a PO/SOW signature within 10 business days, I’m okay with option 1.

—Neha
Account Executive

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Exec approval request — Armitage trial extension & credit (RDW-DEAL-49321)

Laura — need your sign-off on a discretionary credit for Armitage (deal id RDW-DEAL-49321). Context in brief:
- Request: 3-week trial extension + $10–12k usage credit to cover integration testing overrun.
- Current state: engineering progress is positive; procurement delay is the gating factor; customer indicated PO intent.
- Value: potential multi-product deployment and mid-market logo in northeast logistics.
- Financials: expected ARR if converted ~ $120k ARR; CAC is manageable given current pipeline influence.

Recommendation from AE (Diego): option 1 — 2-week extension + $8k credit conditional on signed SOW/PO in 10 business days. This reduces precedent risk while keeping pilot viable.

Request: do you approve option 1 or should we allow the full ask? If you approve partial credit, please confirm any additional conditions (legal review, one-off credit note, accounting tagging).

Thanks — Rishi
VP, Revenue Operations

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 08:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec approval request — Armitage trial extension & credit (RDW-DEAL-49321)

I approve a constrained concession:
- Approve: 2-week extension + $8,000 one-time usage credit.
- Conditions: must be documented as a one-time discretionary credit (do not update our standard PLG policy), SOW must be signed by Armitage procurement and received by Redwood within 10 business days of the credit being granted, and the credit should be applied to trial usage only (no refunds).
- Process: 
  1) Diego to send confirmation to Armitage with the conditions.
  2) Legal to be looped if the SOW contains non-standard billing/term language.
  3) Finance to tag the credit as "one-off pilot concession" (so we avoid recurrence in reporting).

Rishi — please coordinate Legal and Finance for the final paperwork. Diego/Neha — proceed with the confirmation language and get the SOW signed.

—Laura
CTO | Redwood Inference

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kate Morris <kate.morris@armitage.com>, procurement@armitage.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Trial runway extension + usage credits — approved (conditional)

Kate — good news: we can support Armitage with a limited concession to keep the pilot moving.

What Redwood will provide:
- Trial extension: +2 weeks (new trial end date: 2026-09-03).
- One-time usage credit: $8,000 applied to trial usage.

Conditions (please confirm):
1) We need a signed SOW (or PO) from Armitage by close of business on 2026-09-14. If we do not receive signed SOW/PO by then, credits will be rescinded and standard trial terms will resume.
2) Credit applies to trial usage only and is non-refundable.
3) This is a one-time discretionary concession and does not change Redwood’s public PLG credit policy.

Next steps:
- I’ve re-attached the draft SOW for your review. Please have procurement sign and return.
- Rishi will loop Legal/Finance for credit tagging and any SOW redlines.

If that timeline works, I’ll apply the extension and credit today and confirm the updated trial period.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping the momentum.

Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Armitage_SOW_draft.pdf, trial_usage_snapshot_20260827.csv
